help.title: Rules of the count
help.intro: The chair is elected by instant runoff.
help.rule_majority: A candidate with more than half of the continuing ballots is elected.
help.rule_eliminate: Otherwise the candidate with the fewest votes is eliminated and each of their ballots passes to its next choice still in the count.
help.rule_ties: If several candidates share the fewest votes, the one with fewer first preferences goes out; if still level, the one later on the paper.
help.rule_exhausted: A ballot with no choice left in the count is exhausted and no longer counts.
help.rule_tied: If the last two candidates finish level the result is a tie: nobody is elected and no declaration can be made.
help.rule_paper: One paper, one ballot: a paper can be used once.
